2609.11322.title: MultiHuSE: A Multimodal Dataset for Humour Styles and Emotions
2609.11322.paper_summary: Computational recognition of verbal humour remains a challenging task, requiring an understanding of language, delivery style, emotions, and cultural context. Most existing approaches focus on binary classification and lack datasets that capture psychological dimensions of humour alongside variations in expression. We introduce MultiHuSE, a multimodal dataset comprising 2,407 high-definition videos of 50 demographically diverse actors performing 1,463 text samples across four psychological humour styles (affiliative, aggressive, self-enhancing, and self-deprecating), as well as neutral content. A subset is additionally annotated for underlying emotions. The dataset uniquely captures multiple actor interpretations of the same texts, enabling systematic analysis of expressive diversity. Baseline experiments show that multimodal fusion outperforms unimodal approaches (80.1% vs. 77.4% accuracy) in humour style classification, with particularly strong gains for affiliative humour (66% to 74%). While text provides the strongest individual signal, fusion models deliver meaningful improvements. We hope that MultiHuSE provides empirical support for psychological theories linking humour and emotion, while also opening new avenues for research in human communication, well-being, and AI-driven interaction. The dataset is available for academic use under an End-User Licence Agreement.
2609.11322.paper_summary_zh: 計算機對口頭幽默的識別仍然是一項挑戰性任務，這需要對語言、表達風格、情感和文化背景的理解。大多數現有的方法專注於二元分類，並缺乏能夠捕捉幽默的心理維度及表達變化的數據集。我們介紹了MultiHuSE，一個多模態數據集，包含2,407個高畫質視頻，這些視頻由50位人口統計多樣的演員表演1,463個文本樣本，涵蓋四種心理幽默風格（親和、攻擊、自我提升和自我貶低），以及中性內容。子集還附加了潛在情感的標註。該數據集獨特地捕捉了多位演員對相同文本的不同詮釋，使得表達多樣性的系統分析成為可能。基線實驗表明，多模態融合在幽默風格分類中優於單一模態方法（80.1%對77.4%的準確率），特別是在親和幽默方面的增益顯著（從66%增至74%）。雖然文本提供了最強的個體信號，但融合模型帶來了有意義的改進。我們希望MultiHuSE能為將幽默與情感聯繫起來的心理理論提供實證支持，同時開啟人類溝通、福祉和人工智慧驅動互動研究的新途徑。該數據集可根據最終用戶許可協議用於學術研究。
